authorization: Planning only. Every normative correction requires separate Gate B authorization; no implementation or blocker closure occurs here.

responses.ifRejected: Require authoritative exact-operation boundaries and coherent upstream compile-time rejection. Review contextual writable-target restrictions and discriminating positive/negative fixtures. Change EBNF only if a demonstrated syntactic boundary requires it; never encode a runtime invalid-opcode defect.
responses.ifSupported: Require an upstream operand/emission correction where execution fails, then authenticate its immutable source and executable and verify mutation/aliasing controls. Existing broad structural acceptance may need no EBNF change; contextual specification and fixture expectations must reflect the verified operation/result-kind boundary.
responses.ifMixed: Record an operation/result-kind table for ordinary assignment, reference assignment and destructuring across dimension/property writes, compound assignment, unset and reference binding. Review each boundary independently; do not infer blanket permission from reference controls.
responses.ifUnanswered: Remain unresolved. Preserve current grammar and fixtures, retain runtime defect evidence separately from intended validity.

responses.ifUniformValidity: Obtain which outcome is intended for each discarded form. Require upstream compiler/constant-evaluator correction where traversal disagrees, then source-corresponding direct/dynamic/qualified/named/unpack/PFA/initializer regressions. Usually contextual specification and fixture updates, not a function-specific EBNF rule.
responses.ifDispatchDependent: Require an authoritative exact dispatch and elimination boundary. Review bounded contextual wording, enforcement scope and stage expectations; an EBNF change is justified only by an independently established syntax difference. An informal optimization explanation is not sufficient permission.
responses.ifUnanswered: Remain unresolved with the existing informative wording and retained acceptance differences. Do not impose unconditional validation or unreachable runtime evaluation.

responses.ifUniformRejection: Require upstream validation before elimination or an authoritative specified restriction with explicit implementation discrepancy. The get/set EBNF may remain unchanged. Review contextual specification, controlled live/retained/discarded fixtures and bounded conformance claims separately.
responses.ifDiscardedAcceptance: Require the precise short-circuit/constant-initializer/declaration boundary. Review whether a structural hook-name restriction needs a scoped EBNF and contextual revision, or an explicitly adjudicated bounded claim. Never permit unknown names in all live declarations. Any fixture change follows authorized source-backed review; PHP 8.5 corrections remain a separate change.
responses.ifUnanswered: Remain unresolved. Document the structural/compiler divergence without granting an accepted release limitation.

sharedRequirement: A maintainer answer alone does not establish coherent source/executable behavior or satisfy all mixed certification requirements. Retain quoted intent, immutable corrective source, affected forms, regression evidence and release correspondence before proposing closure.
